name: Notebook
location: Core translation interface used throughout the game.
acquisition_hint: Record guessed meanings for encountered graphemes and revise them as new context appears.
uses: Stores graphemes, guessed meanings, and later verified translations.

name: Graphemes
location: Signs, dialogue, labels, terminals, and environmental writing.
acquisition_hint: A grapheme meaning is usually inferred from context, gestures, signs, or repeated usage.
uses: Forms fictional language vocabulary and sentence logic.

name: Notebook Validation Tests
location: Notebook pages after enough graphemes are encountered.
acquisition_hint: Match graphemes to drawings to confirm guessed meanings.
uses: Locks in correct translations and reveals real meanings.
